rationales.authenticity: Conflict between folk medicine and Church is historically apt; yarrow/honey remedy is period-sound.
rationales.character: Thoughtful, principled midwife defending traditional healing against clerical authority.
rationales.craft: Two good sentences but remedy advice tangential; internal thought deepens character.
rationales.language: Good en-IE with 'Aye', 'stirring', dialect feel; clean grammar.
rationales.responsiveness: Fully engages with the theological/cultural tension posed by the priest's sermon.
